privacy_policy:
Privacy Policy

Information used by the shop
When you create an account, contact us, use the chat assistant or place an order, we process the information you provide, including contact details, delivery information, order records and messages. Server logs may contain technical information used to operate and protect the service.

Why we use it
We use this information to manage accounts, answer enquiries, fulfil orders, prepare invoices, provide order updates and investigate misuse. Do not send passwords, full payment card details or other sensitive information through chat or enquiry forms.

Service providers
Hosting, email delivery, payment and AI services may process information needed to perform their functions. Chat messages may be processed by an external AI provider. Payment information submitted to a payment provider is subject to that provider’s terms and privacy notice.

Cookies and local storage
Necessary browser storage supports sign-in, the shopping bag and your privacy preferences. Optional analytics is disabled until you consent and an analytics account is configured. You can change your choice using Cookie settings. Loading an external map connects your browser to Google.

Retention and requests
Contact the shop to request access, correction or deletion of your information. Some records may need to be retained for order fulfilment, accounting, dispute resolution or applicable legal obligations. We may verify your identity before processing a request.

Contact
Use the contact details below for privacy questions. Updates to this policy are recorded with the publication date shown on this page.
terms_policy:
Terms & Conditions

Shopping with New Sahara Gold and Diamond
These terms cover use of our website and orders with New Sahara Gold and Diamond. Please review the product details and contact us if you need clarification before purchasing.

Products and images
Product pages identify the available item, its recorded purity, weight and price. Homepage campaign artwork is editorial and does not identify a particular item for sale. Screens can display colours differently. Ask the shop about measurements or specifications that are important to your purchase.

Rates and prices
Published store rates can be set manually or updated automatically. Market estimates are indicative. Product prices include the components shown in the price breakdown. The server calculates the order total; review your order confirmation and contact us promptly about discrepancies. A displayed rate is not a promise that future prices will remain unchanged.

Orders and payment
Provide accurate contact and delivery details. An order submission is a request to purchase, subject to availability and confirmation. Use only payment methods offered at checkout. Keep your order reference and invoice. Contact us before making changes to a submitted order.

Delivery, cancellation and returns
Contact the shop to confirm delivery timing and any applicable charges. Return, exchange and cancellation terms are described on our Returns page and in the terms provided with your order. Nothing on this website limits rights available under applicable law.

Accounts and acceptable use
Keep sign-in credentials private. Do not attempt to access other customers’ records, interfere with the website or submit abusive or unlawful content. The automated assistant may make mistakes; request confirmation from staff for purchase-critical advice.

Questions
Contact the shop using the details below for order or website questions.
returns_policy:
Returns & Exchanges

Before purchasing
Please ask the shop to confirm the applicable cancellation, exchange, refund and buy-back terms for your item, including custom work, making charges and any deductions. Keep the terms provided with your order and your invoice.

Problems with an order
If an item is damaged, incorrect or does not match the confirmed description, contact us promptly with your order reference and a description of the issue. Keep the item and packaging available for inspection.

Requesting assistance
Contact the shop before returning an item so the team can explain the next steps. Applicable consumer rights are not limited by this notice.
